Subject: Coverage orchestration: Eleni Kaur — cross-team slots & rapid backfills

Team — quick heads-up: we have a candidate, Eleni Kaur (SWE Backend), whose on-site loop next week doubled up because two interviewers flagged PTO last-minute (we only found out after greenlighting the schedule in Greenhouse). Hiring manager is pushing to keep the original Thursday window (29 Jun) to avoid losing momentum.

Current constraints:
- 4-panel loop: System Design (60m), Coding (60m), Product/Tradeoff (45m), Culture/BarRaiser (30m)
- System Design and Coding were assigned to folks who are now out; we need two backfills and at least one shadow for the Product slot (candidate flagged a time preference: 10am–2pm PST).

Ask: can we map slots to available folks and identify at least one cross-functional backup who can step in within 24h if something else changes? I started a quick roster in the Drive (attached v2).

My initial proposals (please reply with accept/reject + any hard blocks):
- System Design (60): Marissa (primary), Jonas (shadow)
- Coding (60): Stephanie (primary)
- Product/Tradeoffs (45): Vivek (primary), Marissa (shadow)
- Culture/BarRaiser (30): Laura (primary)

If you can take a primary slot, confirm and I will update Greenhouse + ping recruiting. If you can only shadow/backup, say so — we'll document on the roster and include swap rules (short notice swap -> slot_swap_agreement.txt).

Attachments: EleniKaur_Resume.pdf, coverage_roster_v2.xlsx

Thanks — I know it's tight. Laura
Laura Bennett
